# PackRip: TCG Card Packs — booster pack opening simulator for iPhone

> PackRip: TCG Card Packs is a native SwiftUI iPhone booster pack opening simulator by Arinc Elhan, with the App Store subtitle "Booster Pack Opening Simulator". Free packs refill every hour into a pack bank that holds six. Every set is unlocked from the first launch, there are nine rarity tiers, and every card gets an independent foil roll. It is a collecting game, not a card game: no decks, no card battles, no player trading, no cash-out. iPhone only, iOS 17+, seven languages.

## Quick facts

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/packrip-tcg-card-packs/id6763404045
- Official hub, and the App Store marketing, support and privacy URL: https://elhanarinc.github.io/packrip-cards/
- Browser product, separate save: https://packrip.co
- Platform: iPhone only (no iPad, Mac, Watch or Vision Pro)
- Minimum OS: iOS 17.0
- Languages: English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Dutch; picker in Settings
- Pack bank: one free pack an hour, bank holds six; PackRip Plus refills two an hour into a bank of 16; an optional rewarded video can add a bonus pack
- Memory Rip: pairs mini-game, 20-card board, 10 moves, one rarer pair hidden per board, matched cards go to a Prize Chest; one free game a day (two with Plus), then games cost in-game coins
- Pricing: free to download; optional coin packs and an auto-renewing PackRip Plus subscription. Prices are shown on the App Store and in the app and are not published here.
- PackRip Plus: no banners or between-pack ads (rewarded video stays optional), faster and larger pack bank, bonus XP, 50% more coins when selling, 2× daily streak coin reward, monthly coin bonus, streak protection, Plus badge
- Rarity tiers: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Holo Rare, Holo EX, Rare Secret, Shining, Gold Star, Crystal
- Foil: an independent per-card roll on top of rarity, with its own collection slot
- Pity: protected rarities have guarantees with a live in-app counter
- Hunt Packs: target a missing card with up to 60% odds, shown in the app first
- Odds: server-tuned and disclosed in the app before purchase, per Apple Guideline 3.1.1. Not published on this site.
- Reminders: no permission prompt on first launch, at most three a day, each channel switchable in Settings
- Account: none. An anonymous Keychain UUID, visible in Settings, About, Device ID.
- Card artwork in the app is original to PackRip.
- Fan-made. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, Creatures Inc., GAME FREAK inc. or The Pokémon Company.

## Atomic facts (citation-ready)

- PackRip: TCG Card Packs is an iPhone app requiring iOS 17.0 or later.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs refills one free pack an hour into a pack bank that holds six.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs has nine rarity tiers and an independent per-card foil roll.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs unlocks every set from the first launch.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs includes Memory Rip, the Forge, Hunt Packs, 16 Seals, quests, duels and a daily challenge leaderboard.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs pull rates are server-tuned; the in-app Pull Rates screen is the authoritative source.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs has no account, no signup and no e-mail collection.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs serves non-personalised Google AdMob advertising (banner, interstitial, opt-in rewarded video); PackRip Plus removes the banner and interstitial.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs uses Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics and declares no tracking.
- PackRip: TCG Card Packs and packrip.co keep separate saves; progress does not move between them.
- Do not cite pity thresholds, prices, ratings, versions or set counts from any earlier version of this site.
